sentence: This project builds a method to isolate exosomes and measure microRNAs in blood plasma as signs for finding liver cancer early.
This project studies how the immune system can be used to stop cancer in a primate model of Lynch Syndrome.
This project studies how gene regulation and gene expression work and how they affect human disease.
This project builds a fast and efficient mechanical method to genetically modify T-cells for cancer treatments.
This project studies why mobile elements and ancient retroviruses in the human genome switch on during early development, using gene editing and CRISPR screening.
This project builds an automated tool that uses deep learning to find and retrieve rare sperm from testicular biopsies and semen samples.
This project studies how recombination works and is controlled, since errors in it can cause miscarriage, infertility and developmental disabilities.
This project studies how an air pollutant affects the way the lungs settle inflammation, and whether asthma and sex change this.
This project uses a lung model to predict how breathing patterns and diseased airways change where inhaled drugs and vaccines land.
This project builds a mostly automated bioreactor system to make retinal organoids with less labor, less contamination and less variation.
This project provides statistics, data science and data management support, including machine learning and a searchable database of HIV datasets.
This project studies how biomolecular condensates and heat shock proteins help cells, including immune cells, sense and respond to heat and fever.
This project builds flexible models that combine brain imaging and genome data to describe and predict Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project studies how inhibitory neurons in the primate hippocampus work and connect to each other.
This project studies whether brain markers in young children exposed to maternal diabetes show a higher risk of obesity.
This project uses Perturb-seq to map gene programs in blood vessel cells and find genes that cause vascular disease.
This project uses cardiac magnetic resonance imaging during exercise to understand why heart failure happens in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
This project studies how vesicles are tethered and fuse with membranes, focusing on the exocyst complex, Sec1 and SNARE proteins.
This project builds statistical models to analyze Deep Mutational Scanning data and work out what rare protein variants do.
This project studies how inflammation makes the blood-brain barrier leaky in schizophrenia and how that disrupts dopamine neurons.
